items.question: How much does a custom website cost?
items.answer: Custom websites at Blok Blok Studio start at $2,000 for a single landing page and scale to $9,500 for a 10-page site with a CMS, branding, and on-page SEO. Pricing depends on the number of pages, custom animations, AI integrations, and copywriting needs. Every site is built in Next.js, hosted on Vercel, and SEO-optimized from day one, never templates.

items.question: How much does an AI chatbot cost to build?
items.answer: An AI chatbot trained on 100+ Q&A pairs and embedded site-wide is included in our $18,000 Conversational AI suite, which also covers a voice agent, SMS automations, and a full content pipeline. As a standalone add-on to a website tier, an AI chatbot starts at $2,500. All bots integrate with your CRM and capture leads 24/7.

items.question: How much does an AI voice agent cost per month?
items.answer: Our AI voice agent setup starts at $2,500 one-time, with 500 voice minutes included for the first month. Ongoing minutes are billed at standard telephony rates and rolled into a monthly retainer. The agent answers calls, qualifies leads, books appointments, and routes urgent calls to a human, all in natural conversational language.

items.question: Do you offer monthly retainers or just project work?
items.answer: Both. Project work starts at $2,000 and is billed in milestones. Retainers start at $1,500/month for site maintenance, AI monitoring, and CRM upkeep, or $3,500/month for full-service growth, Google and Meta ads management, AI-assisted content production, and 5 hours of dev work each month. Retainers require a 3 or 6 month minimum.

items.question: How long does it take to build a custom website?
items.answer: A single landing page typically launches in 2 to 3 weeks. A 5-page site takes 4 to 6 weeks. A 10-page site with CMS and AI integrations takes 8 to 12 weeks. Timeline depends on how quickly you provide content, brand input, and approvals. We move fast, most agencies take 2 to 3 times longer.

items.question: How long does it take to deploy an AI agent?
items.answer: A standard AI chatbot trained on your existing FAQs is live in 7 to 10 business days. A voice agent with a custom call script takes 10 to 14 days. A full multi-agent ecosystem with CRM, calendar, and payment integrations takes 4 to 8 weeks depending on complexity. We start with a discovery call, then a paid scoping document, then build.

items.question: What does the design and build process look like?
items.answer: Five phases: Discovery (your goals and audience), Strategy (a tailored roadmap), Design (visual concepts and prototypes), Development (modern, performant code), and Launch & Optimize (deploy, monitor, refine). You get weekly updates and a Loom walkthrough at every milestone, no live status meetings unless you want one.

items.question: What's the difference between an AI chatbot and an AI voice agent?
items.answer: An AI chatbot is text-based and lives on your website or in messaging apps, it answers FAQs, books appointments, and captures leads through chat. An AI voice agent answers actual phone calls in natural spoken language. Voice agents are best for inbound sales, after-hours support, and appointment confirmations. Many businesses run both for full coverage.

items.question: Can your AI agents integrate with HubSpot, Salesforce, or GoHighLevel?
items.answer: Yes. Our AI agents and automations integrate with HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Pipedrive, Airtable, Google Workspace, Stripe, and Calendly natively. For CRMs and tools without an existing integration, we build a custom connector, no Zapier middleman tax. Your data stays in your systems; we just make them talk to each other.

items.question: Do you build websites in Next.js, WordPress, or Webflow?
items.answer: We build exclusively in Next.js with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Sites are hosted on Vercel for sub-second load times and global edge delivery. We do not build in WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, or Webflow, those platforms can't deliver the performance, custom animations, or AI integrations our clients need.

items.question: Do you write the website copy, or do I provide it?
items.answer: Either works. Most clients provide raw notes or bullet points and we shape them into final copy. Full professional copywriting is included at our $18,000 tier and available as a $200/page add-on at any other tier. Ad copy for Google and Meta campaigns is always written by us when we manage the ads.

items.question: Where is Blok Blok Studio located, and do you work internationally?
items.answer: Our studio is based in Berlin, Germany. We work with clients in the United States, United Kingdom, the Netherlands, France, Spain, and across the EU. Communication is asynchronous via Loom, email, and text, we accommodate every time zone. Invoicing and contracts are available in USD or EUR depending on your preference.

items.question: Do I own my website code and AI agent configurations?
items.answer: Yes, completely. On project completion you receive full ownership of the code, design files, AI prompts, and automation configurations. The site is deployed to your own Vercel account under your billing. The CRM, ad accounts, and domains stay in your name from day one. We never lock clients into our systems.

items.question: Will my site be mobile-responsive and SEO-optimized?
items.answer: Yes, both are non-negotiable in every build. Mobile-first responsive design is tested at 375px, 768px, 1024px, and 1440px. Every page ships with meta titles, descriptions, schema markup, alt text, and a sitemap submitted to Google. We target Lighthouse scores of 90+ for performance and 95+ for accessibility before launch.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Blok Blok Studio collects, uses, and protects your personal data
privacy.intro_content: At Blok Blok Studio, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.
privacy.data_collection_intro: We collect information you provide directly to us when you fill out forms on our website:
privacy.data_item_budget: Budget range and desired timeline (when you tell us on the enquiry form)

privacy.use_item_marketing: Send marketing communications (only with your explicit consent)
privacy.third_parties_intro: We use the following third-party services to operate our business:
privacy.third_parties_note: These services only receive the minimum data necessary for their functionality.
privacy.retention_content: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to provide our services and maintain our business relationship. You can request deletion of your data at any time through our Data Rights page.
privacy.your_rights_intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation, you have the right to:
privacy.right_access: Access. Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you
privacy.right_correct: Rectification. Request correction of inaccurate data
privacy.right_delete: Erasure. Request permanent deletion of your data
privacy.right_object: Object. Object to processing of your data
privacy.right_export: Portability. Export your data in a machine-readable format
privacy.right_withdraw: Withdraw Consent. Withdraw your consent at any time
privacy.contact_content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, contact us at:
privacy.third_party_pixels: We only load advertising pixels (Meta, Google) if you explicitly accept marketing cookies in our consent banner; otherwise no tracking cookies or analytics services are used.
privacy.legal_basis_intro: Under Article 6 of the GDPR, we process your personal data based on the following legal grounds:
privacy.legal_basis_consent: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): When you subscribe to our newsletter or submit a contact form with explicit consent
privacy.legal_basis_contract: Contractual Necessity (Art. 6(1)(b)): When processing is necessary to fulfill a service agreement with you
privacy.legal_basis_interest: Legitimate Interest (Art. 6(1)(f)): For internal analytics, improving our services, and protecting the security of our website
privacy.legal_basis_withdraw: You may withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.
privacy.transfers_intro: Some of our third-party service providers may process your data outside the European Economic Area (EEA). When this occurs, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place:
privacy.transfers_vercel: Vercel: Our hosting provider may process data in the United States. Vercel complies with applicable data protection frameworks.
privacy.transfers_resend: Resend: Our email delivery provider may process data in the United States. Transfers are covered by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).
privacy.transfers_note: We only transfer data to countries or organizations that provide an adequate level of protection or where appropriate safeguards (such as SCCs or binding corporate rules) are in place.
privacy.authority_content: If you believe that our processing of your personal data violates the GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority in the EU member state of your habitual residence, place of work, or place of the alleged infringement. You may also contact us first so we can try to resolve the issue directly.
privacy.third_party_vercel: Vercel: website and application hosting (USA; data protection frameworks and SCCs apply)
privacy.third_party_slack: Slack: internal notifications about new inquiries to our team (limited to name, email, phone, and business type)
privacy.third_party_turnstile: Cloudflare Turnstile: spam protection on our forms (processes your IP address)
privacy.third_party_cal: Cal.com, appointment scheduling when you book a call with us
privacy.third_party_meta: Meta (Facebook/Instagram): advertising measurement, only with your marketing-cookie consent. With that consent we may also transmit your email address and phone number in hashed (pseudonymized) form to measure ad conversions.
privacy.third_party_google: Google: advertising measurement (Google Ads), only with your marketing-cookie consent
privacy.marketing_double_optin: Marketing emails use double opt-in. Ticking the optional box on a form is not enough on its own: we send a confirmation email, and you are only added to the list once you click the link in it. Until then we do not send you marketing. You can withdraw at any time using the unsubscribe link in any email, which takes effect immediately.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.commitment_content: Blok Blok Studio is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We are continually improving the user experience for everyone and applying the relevant accessibility standards across our website and the websites we build for clients.
accessibility.conformance_intro: The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) define requirements for designers and developers to improve accessibility for people with disabilities. They define three levels of conformance: Level A, Level AA, and Level AAA.
accessibility.conformance_status: blokblokstudio.com is partially conformant with WCAG 2.2 level AA. “Partially conformant” means that some parts of the content do not fully conform to the accessibility standard. See the known limitations section below for details.
accessibility.standard_wcag: WCAG 2.2 Level AA, the international baseline for web accessibility maintained by the W3C.
accessibility.standard_en301549: EN 301 549, the European harmonized standard for ICT accessibility that underpins the European Accessibility Act.
accessibility.standard_eaa: EU European Accessibility Act (Directive 2019/882), applicable to consumer-facing digital services in the EU since 28 June 2025.
accessibility.standard_ada: US Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), Title III, accessibility obligations for public-facing commercial websites in the United States.
accessibility.standard_508: Section 508 of the US Rehabilitation Act, requirements for federal agencies and contractors, which we treat as a baseline for federal-adjacent work.
accessibility.measures_intro: Accessibility is part of how we design and build, not a one-time audit. Specifically, on this site:
accessibility.measure_landmarks: Semantic HTML landmarks (main, nav, header, footer) on every page.
accessibility.measure_skip_link: A “skip to main content” link for keyboard users.
accessibility.measure_focus: Visible focus indicators on every interactive element.
accessibility.measure_alt_text: Text alternatives on all meaningful images.
accessibility.measure_forms: Forms with associated labels, required-field announcements, and inline error messages exposed via aria-describedby and role=“alert”.
accessibility.measure_dialogs: Mobile menu and modal dialogs with keyboard focus management and Escape-to-close behavior.
accessibility.measure_reduced_motion: Respect for the prefers-reduced-motion setting in your operating system.
accessibility.measure_contrast: Color contrast meeting or exceeding WCAG AA (4.5:1 for body text).
accessibility.measure_rtl: Right-to-left layout for Arabic, and a language switcher that announces each option in its native language and direction.
accessibility.measure_languages: Site available in 19 languages so non-English speakers can use it in the language they think in.
accessibility.limitations_intro: Despite our best efforts, some content on this site may not be fully accessible yet. Known issues we are working to resolve:
accessibility.limitation_third_party: Embedded third-party content, the Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA and the Cal.com booking iframe inherit their own accessibility behavior from the upstream vendor. We track their conformance status with each vendor.
accessibility.limitation_motion: Decorative motion, ambient background animations are disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is set, but a small number of cursor-magnetic micro-interactions may still play.
accessibility.limitation_language: Statement language, this statement is currently maintained in English only. The site itself is localized into 19 languages.
accessibility.feedback_intro: If you encounter an accessibility barrier on blokblokstudio.com, or need information from this site in an alternative format, please contact us. We aim to respond to accessibility feedback within five business days.
accessibility.feedback_form: Web form: Contact page, please mention “accessibility” in your message.
accessibility.enforcement_intro: Blok Blok Studio is registered in Germany. If you are not satisfied with our response to your accessibility feedback, you can escalate under your local enforcement framework:
accessibility.enforcement_eu: European Union, the market surveillance authority of the EU member state in which you are located. The EAA designates a national authority in each member state.
accessibility.enforcement_us: United States, the US Department of Justice Civil Rights Division for ADA complaints; the US Access Board for Section 508.
accessibility.preparation_content: This statement was prepared on {date} via a self-evaluation of the site against WCAG 2.2 AA. The evaluation combined an automated review of the live site with a manual review of the codebase (semantic structure, keyboard navigation, focus management, ARIA usage, color contrast, motion handling, and locale direction). We re-review the site after every significant release.
